system.description:
Rigging is the knowledge of setting the sails of seagoing vessels. This includes how they work, and the ability to climb the rigging like a monkey climbs a tree.

Obstacles: A sailboat or longboat, Ob 1. Single mast (sampan, cog, balinger, longship), Ob 2. Junk, Ob 3. Felucca, Ob 4. Carrack, Ob 5. Caravel, Ob 6. A large seagoing vessel with many masts, Ob 7.

FoRKs: Knots

Skill Type: Seafaring. Tools: No.

Root: Agility/Speed

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 291
